research.community: Bay Grove Residences · Dubai Islands, Island B
overview: The final release contains Buildings 12–15 around a shared podium and basement. Its mix includes one- to four-bedroom apartments and a four-bedroom penthouse; Building 15 concentrates the larger four-bedroom homes.
research.locationNote: In the Marina District on Island B of Dubai Islands, off Deira. The project programme includes Crystal Beach access and waterfront walking and cycling routes. Confirm the particular building and contractual access rights; marketed views vary by apartment.
research.priceNote: The official final-release sheet lists AED 2m for one bedroom, AED 3.11m for two, AED 3.92m for two plus maid, AED 4.94m for three and AED 10.33m for four. A penthouse-specific price is not given. These are launch references, not verified live availability.
research.paymentNote: The final-release sheet gives 20% on booking, 50% through dated instalments and 30% at handover. Some instalment dates are already past at review; a new reservation needs a fresh written schedule. These terms must not be transferred to earlier Bay Grove phases.
research.handoverNote: The final-release payment sheet estimates construction completion in June 2029. Nakheel’s 26 October 2026 announcement also anticipates Phase 4 completion in Q2 2029; it separately expects Phase 2 main construction by late 2028. Confirm the purchased building’s contractual handover, including any subsequent revisions.

facts.label: Whole collection versus final phase
facts.value: The October 2026 construction award identifies 1,154 planned homes across 15 buildings. Phase 4 accounts for 257 homes in four buildings, Phase 2 for 360 in four, and Phases 1/ 3 together for 537 in seven.

facts.label: Plan layout examples
facts.value: The selected one-bedroom drawing has a laundry, powder room and walk-in closet. The two-/three-bedroom examples add a maid room. These features describe the cited layouts rather than every unit.

unresolved: Current inventory, final specification, service charges, exact parking allocations and binding unit handover require developer confirmation.

This project record covers the whole collection but its prices, payments and example areas are explicitly from the final release. Earlier phase figures and original 296-home launch should not be treated as the final development total.

The floor-plan PDF includes obsolete hidden text in some pages. Only visually confirmed final-phase tables were used. Areas include outdoor space and are not internal usable-area measures. Images remain illustrative.
